title: John Mayer Returns for Live Thanksgiving Broadcast on SiriusXM
summary: Tune in as John Mayer takes listener calls, plays holiday favorites, and celebrates Thanksgiving live on Life with John Mayer.
body_markdown:
For the fourth consecutive year,[John Mayer](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/john-mayer) is celebrating[Thanksgiving](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/thanksgiving) with a special live broadcast from the SiriusXM studios.


On Thursday, November 26 at 1pm ET (10am PT), tune in to[Life with John Mayer (Ch. 4)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/life-with-john-mayer) on SiriusXM as John takes listener calls, plays holiday favorites, and keeps you company throughout the holiday.


[Life with John Mayer The ever-changing playlist Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogThanksgivingJohnMayer)


The Thanksgiving tradition has delivered some unforgettable moments. Last year, John answered a fan’s question with a live Grateful Dead guitar solo.[Revisit the performance](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/john-mayer-grateful-dead-guitar-solo) below ahead of this year’s broadcast.


> [View this post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df7y3kcMpBX/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)


### About Life with John Mayer


[Life with John Mayer](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/life-with-john-mayer) is John’s exclusive, year-round SiriusXM channel, featuring an ever-evolving mix of his music, collaborations, personal favorites, and previously unreleased material. Curated by Mayer himself, the channel offers a soundtrack that changes with the time of day and day of the week.


Listen on SiriusXM Channel 4 and the SiriusXM app.
